description: Read the Oxford Ledge news archive by ticker and/or keyword, newest first. Default limit 25, hard cap 100; no pagination offset. THE RESPONSE SHAPE DEPENDS ON THE ARGUMENTS: ticker only returns {articles, total}; any free-text query returns {articles, count} with richer rows (publisher, snippet, sentimentScore, tickers, tags). Handle both. `sentiment` is a LABEL string, NOT a number. Query matching is prefix-word, not semantic. Source: Oxford Ledge news archive (multi-provider, cron-populated). Caveats ride the response's tool_notes. Needs an Oxford Ledge API key that the client's operator configures; anonymous callers are refused.

ticker.description: Filter to a specific ticker (e.g. AAPL)
